#Feature Request

## Description
A clear and concise description of the desired feature or mod for the modpack.

## Use Case
Describe how this mod or feature would be used during gameplay and what problem it solves.

## Expected Behavior
A clear description of how the mod should integrate into the gameplay.

## Technical Aspects
- [ ] Requires server-side installation
- [ ] Client-side only
- [ ] Compatible with existing mods
- Minecraft Version: ________________

## Mod Recommendation
If you have a specific mod in mind, provide the name and if possible a link:
- Mod Name: ________________
- Link: ________________
- Version: ________________

## Mod Configuration
If you have suggestions for configuring the mod, describe them here.

## Known Conflicts
Are you aware of any potential conflicts with other mods in the pack?

## Priority
- [ ] Low (would be nice to have)
- [ ] Medium (would improve the gameplay experience)
- [ ] High (solves a significant problem)

## Own Contribution
- [ ] I have already tested this mod
- [ ] I could help with configuration/integration
- [ ] I could write documentation for this mod
